project_name: Future Flex V2 - Sistema Inteligente de Gestão Financeira Pessoal

typography.strategy: Geometric Sans for confidence, Monospace for precise financial data.

numbers_and_data.usage: Use strictly for balances, transaction amounts, dates, and percentages.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid crisp borders for structure. No soft, muddy dropshadows.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Use inner glowing borders (box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.1)) instead of heavy outer shadows.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used only for mobile bottom nav and sticky top headers: backdrop-blur-xl bg-zinc-950/80 border-b (or top) border-white/10.
visual_enhancers.texture: Subtle noise on main background to remove digital flatness.

components.bottom_nav_mobile: Fixed bottom. Glassmorphism effect. Central FAB for '+ Registrar' must overlap the bar, colored in primary (#CCFF00) with dark icon.
components.sidebar_desktop: Collapsible left sidebar for desktop. Solid dark background (#09090B) with 1px right border. High-density navigation links.
components.cards: Flat solid surfaces (#18181B) with 1px border. No shadows. Internal padding p-4 or p-6.

buttons.primary: bg-[#CCFF00] text-black font-semibold rounded-md hover:bg-[#B3E600] transition-colors

components.inputs: Shadcn based. bg-zinc-900 border-zinc-800 focus:border-[#CCFF00] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#CCFF00].
components.modals_drawers: Use Drawer for mobile-first interactions (bottom sheet). Use Dialog for desktop. Dark overlay bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm.
components.charts: Recharts or Shadcn Charts. Thin bright lines. Subdued gridlines. Color palette tuned for dark contrast (e.g., Emerald for income, Rose for expense).

grids_and_layouts.strategy: The High-Density Grid Protocol (Mode B). Dense, data-heavy, scannable.
grids_and_layouts.desktop: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 or gap-6. Left Sidebar + Main Content.
grids_and_layouts.mobile: Mobile-first approach. 100% width cards, stacked layout, bottom padding to account for fixed bottom navigation (pb-24).

motion.transitions: Specific property transitions only (e.g. transition-colors duration-200). DO NOT use 'transition: all'.
motion.interactions: Buttons scale slightly on active (active:scale-95). List items staggered fade-in.
motion.numbers: Count-up animations for main balances (Saldo, Dinheiro Livre) when mounted.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text meets APCA/WCAG AA standards. #FAFAFA on #09090B is highly legible. Avoid dark gray text on black backgrounds.
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings on all inputs/buttons (focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[#CCFF00]).
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='add-transaction-btn', data-testid='balance-amount').

media_and_icons.empty_states: Use abstract minimalist SVGs or typography-driven empty states rather than generic vector illustrations.

image_urls.description: Minimalist black sand texture, use as an extremely low opacity (10-15%) background image or hero section texture overlay to give depth.
Dark blue crumpled paper background, can be used for abstract textured cards or auth screen backdrop.

instructions_to_main_agent.setup: Install JetBrains Mono and Outfit fonts. Configure Tailwind with specific brand colors.
instructions_to_main_agent.architecture: Build a responsive layout shell. Sidebar on md+ screens, Bottom Nav on small screens.
instructions_to_main_agent.core_feature: Build the 'Compromissos do Mês' interface with a top-level North Star metric (Dinheiro Livre / Free Money).
instructions_to_main_agent.visual_distinction: Implement the 'Previsto' (future) vs 'Realizado' (actual) styling exact specifications from this document.
instructions_to_main_agent.form_elements: Use Shadcn Form, Select, DatePicker components for transaction entries.
instructions_to_main_agent.charts: Integrate Shadcn Chart / Recharts for the 24-month projection.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) only where appropriate (headers, bottom nav).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all). This breaks transforms. Always add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add '.App { text-align: center; }'.
Always use modern button styles with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💡🔮) for icons. Use Lucide icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.
